author: TotallyBeast
body: Hello there, I know I have been banned, but I am going to give this one last shot. If someone would respond that would help. I love this server. I love everyone on it. My friend _HyperShock_ is also banned and I feel sorry for him as well. I miss this server and everyone on it. I will do anything to get unbanned. I will pay, I will beg, (lol), I will do anything. Really, I will. I love this server so much I bought a kit. The best kit! I would like to put my money to good use! If someone were to give me a second chance, I will truly be grateful. I know I ban evaded _HyperShock_ and I am sorry for doing so. I do admit that I did that and I am deeply sorry for doing that. I had never read the rules and I should have looked at them before I said anything. I promise you that I will memorize every rule there is to get back on this server. I will do anything. Please give me another chance. I know, I ban evaded _HyperShock_, but I did not know it was a rule. If you could give me one last chance, it would be amazing. I know it has been forever since this happened, but I miss this server. I love building and battling and all I want is to play on this server again. I'm sorry. -TotallyBeast (Beast09)

replies.body: If you wish to appeal your ban, you appeal here at www.avicus.net/appeals. I wish you luck on your appeal :D!
